title: PH may appeal possible death sentence for Filipino in Laos drug bust

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine authorities will likely ask the Laotian government to commute any death sentence imposed on a Filipino arrested in connection with the seizure of a private aircraft loaded with half a ton of shabu (methamphetamine hydrochloride), National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) officer Ross Jonathan Galicia said Thursday. Galicia, chief of the NBI’s Dangerous Drugs Division, said Laos “is a communist state where the death penalty is imposed for drug trafficking,” and the Philippine government would assist the Filipino with his case “whether we like it or not.” “Presumably, we’re going to ask that the death penalty be reduced […]...
